vibe_rationale: Long-running hinterland makers and food market since 1982 with a strong local base, but broad and market-led rather than a curated subculture.
fit_notes: Adult hinterland crowd with a relaxed food and makers angle, so a stall or sampling presence is a low-cost test. No sponsors or partnership route are visible and no attendance is published, so reach is unproven; it is an NSW market, so direct activation is possible.
